docs.summary: Imports .navmesh files - Echo-serialized NavMeshData objects (baked navigation meshes). Binary, because a navmesh is almost entirely compressed voxelization blobs: as text they are base64, which is larger, slower to parse, and undiffable anyway.
Bumping this reimports every .navmesh. A text-written one does not parse as binary, so it fails the import rather than loading wrong — rebake it.
How the source file holds the asset when it is the asset itself written by Echo, which is what lets an edit made in memory be saved back to it. None for a file imported from any other format.
Import a raw asset file. Push results into ctx via SetMainAsset/AddSubAsset.
